summary: Tested banking-expenses feature end-to-end on public preview URL (backend APIs + UI integration). Core requested flows passed: module card visibility after login, /banking-expenses load, filters/table render, banking status toggles, manual charges save, and Excel/Word export downloads.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after 5 failed attempts (fail_1..fail_5=401 then success_after_fails=200).
No app-issued HttpOnly auth cookie observed; response contains JWT in body and only Cloudflare cookie in headers.
access-control-allow-origin remains '*' while allow_credentials=true; not explicit allowlist posture.
Existing admin exits early in ensure_default_admin(), so changed ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD is not reconciled (non-idempotent seed behavior).

action_items: If security policy expects cookie session auth, set app-issued HttpOnly cookie on successful login.
Replace wildcard CORS origin with explicit allowlist when credentials are allowed.
Make ensure_default_admin idempotent by updating existing admin password hash when env password changes.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a large monolith (>1700 lines), increasing regression and maintenance risk; split into routers/services/models.
hash_password() uses bcrypt.gensalt() path compatible with $2b$ bcrypt format expectation.
Banking expenses calculations live in frontend only; no dedicated backend reporting endpoint exists for centralized validation at scale.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST ITER20 UI banking revenue/expense records for status-control UI validation, then cleaned them via cleanup test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banking-expenses requested flows are passing in both API and UI, including Excel/Word export trigger and status button interactions. Seed test data is cleaned. Remaining open items are auth hardening gaps (lockout/cookie/CORS) and seed-admin idempotency.
rca of the issue: Auth hardening RCA: login handler has direct credential check with no failed-attempt state/lockout branch and returns token in JSON body without setting app session cookie. CORS middleware is configured with allow_origins from env default '*'. Admin seeding RCA: ensure_default_admin() returns immediately when any admin exists, so ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes are not applied to existing admin.
